seo.title: DeFi Protocol Launch Checklist
seo.description: DeFi protocol launch checklist covering security audits, liquidity bootstrapping, and monitoring. 65+ items for mainnet readiness.

content.intro: The complete checklist for launching a DeFi protocol. Covers security audits, liquidity bootstrapping, monitoring setup, and safe mainnet deployment for lending protocols, DEXs, and yield aggregators.

items.title: Complete professional security audit
items.description: Engage reputable audit firm. Allow 4-8 weeks for thorough review.

items.title: Fix all critical and high audit findings
items.description: No launch with unresolved critical issues. Document any accepted risks.

items.title: Run bug bounty program
items.description: Launch on Immunefi or similar. Set meaningful bounty amounts.

items.title: Complete formal verification for core functions
items.description: Use Certora, Halmos, or similar for critical invariants.

items.title: Run extensive fuzzing campaigns
items.description: Echidna/Foundry fuzzing for all financial operations.

items.title: Review all external dependencies
items.description: Audit imported libraries. Check for known vulnerabilities.

items.title: Conduct economic security review
items.description: Model attack economics, MEV, and manipulation vectors.

items.title: Set up security monitoring
items.description: Configure Forta bots, Tenderly alerts, or custom monitoring.

items.title: Set conservative initial parameters
items.description: Lower TVL caps, higher collateral ratios, wider spreads for launch.

items.title: Configure asset listings carefully
items.description: Start with battle-tested assets (ETH, USDC). Add riskier assets later.

items.title: Set supply and borrow caps
items.description: Limit exposure per asset until protocol is battle-tested.

items.title: Configure oracle feeds
items.description: Use Chainlink primary with fallbacks. Set staleness thresholds.

items.title: Set liquidation incentives
items.description: Ensure liquidators are profitable to maintain solvency.

items.title: Configure interest rate models
items.description: Set utilization targets and rate curves appropriately.

items.title: Set fee parameters
items.description: Configure protocol fees, withdrawal fees, and distribution.

items.title: Configure governance timelock
items.description: Set appropriate delay (24-48h minimum) for parameter changes.

items.title: Deploy governance multisig
items.description: Use Gnosis Safe with reputable signers. Document threshold.

items.title: Transfer ownership to multisig
items.description: Move all admin rights from deployer to governance.

items.title: Configure emergency guardian
items.description: Set up fast-response guardian for pause functionality.

items.title: Document all privileged roles
items.description: Public documentation of who controls what.

items.title: Set up key ceremony for critical keys
items.description: Proper key generation with multiple witnesses.

items.title: Configure upgrade authority
items.description: Set timelock as upgrade admin for proxies.

items.title: Test emergency procedures
items.description: Dry run pause, unpause, and emergency actions.

items.title: Plan key rotation procedures
items.description: Document how to rotate signers if needed.

items.title: Plan liquidity bootstrapping strategy
items.description: Choose LBP, fair launch, liquidity mining, or VC seeding.

items.title: Secure initial liquidity commitments
items.description: Line up launch liquidity from team, investors, or partners.

items.title: Design liquidity incentive program
items.description: Structure rewards to attract sticky liquidity, not mercenary.

items.title: Set up liquidity mining contracts
items.description: Deploy and test reward distribution contracts.

items.title: Coordinate with DEX aggregators
items.description: List on 1inch, Paraswap, etc. for discoverability.

items.title: Plan trading pair strategy
items.description: Prioritize deep liquidity for key pairs.

items.title: Set up token vesting if applicable
items.description: Configure vesting schedules for team and investors.

items.title: Prepare treasury management
items.description: Plan how protocol-owned liquidity will be managed.

items.title: Deploy and index subgraph
items.description: The Graph or custom indexer for protocol analytics.

items.title: Set up protocol dashboard
items.description: Real-time TVL, utilization, and health metrics.

items.title: Configure liquidation bots
items.description: Run redundant liquidation bots or partner with liquidators.

items.title: Set up keeper infrastructure
items.description: Automated keepers for oracle updates, rewards, etc.

items.title: Configure alerting system
items.description: PagerDuty or similar for critical alerts.

items.title: Set up 24/7 on-call rotation
items.description: Ensure someone can respond to incidents anytime.

items.title: Deploy frontend to reliable hosting
items.description: CDN with DDoS protection. Consider IPFS backup.

items.title: Configure RPC redundancy
items.description: Multiple RPC providers with automatic failover.

items.title: Publish comprehensive docs
items.description: Protocol mechanics, risks, and user guides.

items.title: Write risk disclosure
items.description: Clear documentation of protocol risks for users.

items.title: Prepare audit report publication
items.description: Make audit reports easily accessible.

items.title: Create integration documentation
items.description: SDK docs, contract addresses, and integration guides.

items.title: Brief community moderators
items.description: Train mods on protocol mechanics and common issues.

items.title: Prepare launch announcements
items.description: Blog posts, tweets, and press materials ready.

items.title: Set up support channels
items.description: Discord support, FAQ, and escalation paths.

items.title: Coordinate launch PR
items.description: Reach out to media, influencers, and partners.

items.title: Final testnet validation
items.description: Complete end-to-end testing on testnet fork of mainnet.

items.title: Deploy contracts to mainnet
items.description: Execute deployment scripts. Verify all contracts.

items.title: Seed initial liquidity
items.description: Deploy committed liquidity before opening to public.

items.title: Enable deposits with caps
items.description: Start with conservative caps. Raise as confidence grows.

items.title: Monitor first transactions closely
items.description: Watch initial deposits, borrows, and trades for issues.

items.title: Verify oracle functionality
items.description: Confirm price feeds are working correctly.

items.title: Test emergency pause
items.description: Verify pause functionality works without affecting funds.

items.title: Announce launch
items.description: Publish announcements once system is stable.

items.title: Monitor protocol health daily
items.description: Check TVL, utilization, bad debt, and anomalies.

items.title: Gradually raise caps
items.description: Increase limits as protocol proves stability.

items.title: Process bug bounty submissions
items.description: Triage and respond to security reports quickly.

items.title: Maintain community communication
items.description: Regular updates on metrics, roadmap, and issues.

items.title: Plan next asset listings
items.description: Due diligence on new assets before adding.

items.title: Schedule follow-up audits
items.description: Plan audits for new features and periodic reviews.

items.title: Gather user feedback
items.description: Collect feedback for product improvements.

items.title: Document lessons learned
items.description: Record what worked and what to improve.

proTips: Launch with lower caps than you think you need: You can always raise caps. You can't undo a hack. Start conservative.
Have war room ready for launch week: Engineering, security, and ops should be available 24/7 for the first week.
Partner with professional liquidators: Don't rely solely on your own bots. Liquidation failures cause bad debt.
Monitor competitor incidents: When similar protocols get hacked, review if you're vulnerable to the same attack.
Build relationships with security researchers: White hats who know your protocol can spot issues before black hats do.
content.conclusion: DeFi protocols handle real money. Treat every checklist item as non-negotiable before mainnet. Schedule periodic re-audits as the threat model evolves.
